name: Courtyard House
description: Siheyuan, a traditional courtyard-style building with a history of more than 3,000 years, is a symbol of traditional Chinese culture. Its layout is surrounded by houses on four sides and a courtyard in the middle, which means perfection and harmony. The structure is centrally symmetrical, reflecting the theory of Yin and Yang and the Five Elements. In the streets and alleys shaded by green trees, the courtyard houses exude a unique historical charm and oriental style, telling the story of time. Let’s put together a metal puzzle of a courtyard, and create an impression of the East in just a few inches.
